article.title: Israel’s attacks on Gaza’s education: The students and teachers killed in October
article.author: Editor
article.content: Fourteen Palestinian students, the youngest just six years old, were killed in Israeli attacks across Gaza in October. The post Israel’s attacks on Gaza’s education: The students and teachers killed in October appeared first on MR Online .
